title: The Voice: How a Spinning Red Chair Took Over the World | Papel Tales
description:
Why do the coaches on The Voice sit with their backs turned? This paper-cut story explains how the world's most famous singing show began, from a Dutch TV challenge to the big red chairs in America and the Philippines.
